### `test_show_draws_the_cross_section_unchanged(hybrid_column)` *(line 402)*
show() plots the Signal's array, on the same cell edges the old code used.

Guards the refactor of `assemblies._scaled_wave_cross_section`: `show()` now draws from `Microscope.wave_cross_section_signal()`, and `_cross_section_before_refactor` in this file is a frozen copy of the old inline computation. The plotted array and cell edges must stay bit-identical. Image-plane lines are compared with `allclose`, because they now come from the hybrid run's `image_planes` (equal to the traced ones to 1e-16 m). See [../assemblies.md](../assemblies.md), Display Signals.

### `test_display_signals_never_copy_the_column(hybrid_column, monkeypatch)` *(line 457)*
A column that refuses deepcopy -- as one bound to a live backend does -- still derives every view.

The coordinator's 2026-10-12 rule: a hosted sea-pearl `MicroscopeModel` cannot be deep-copied (its backend holds the vendor transport), so no display Signal may call `conjugate_planes()` or anything else that copies or re-propagates the column. The column holds a `threading.Lock`; reverting to `conjugate_planes()` makes this test raise `TypeError`.
